title: Drag Race: The Simulator
excerpt: Charisma. Uniqueness. Nerve. Talent. Long ago in the year 2013, I had none of these qualities. I came across a Q&A video on the web. The question asked: “Are you watching the current season of Drag Race? If so, who are you rooting for to snatch the crown?” A crown? For drag racing? No, this was something much much gayer.
